model-first.howto.editproduct:
✏️ To change a price, say the product's name and the new price, for example:

"{0} is now 2000"

I will ask you first, then change it.
model-first.howto.showcatalog:
📦 To see your products, say or type:

"show my products" or "catalog"
model-first.howto.addcustomer:
👤 To add a new customer, say or type the name, phone and address, for example:

"New customer Bilal Ahmed, 03001234567, Gulberg Lahore"
model-first.howto.editcustomer:
✏️ To change a customer's phone or address, say for example:

"Sara's phone is 03001234567" or "Sara's address is now Model Town"
model-first.howto.showcustomer:
👤 For a customer's details, ask with the name, for example:

"what is Sara's number" or "show my customers"
model-first.howto.updatestatus:
🚚 To change an order's status, say for example:

"order 2 has been sent" or "Sara's order was delivered" or "order 3 came back"
model-first.howto.cancelorder:
❌ To cancel an order, say or type:

"cancel order 2"

I will ask you first.
model-first.howto.showorders:
📋 To see orders, say or type:

"show today's orders", "pending orders" or "show order 2"
model-first.howto.showsummary:
📊 To see the summary, say or type:

"today's summary" or "how much did I sell this week"
model-first.howto.undo:
↩️ To reverse my last action, type:

undo
